allow: PowerShell($listener = New-Object System.Net.HttpListener; $listener.Prefixes.Add\('http://localhost:3000/'\); $listener.Start\(\); Write-Host "Server started at http://localhost:3000"; while \($true\) { $ctx = $listener.GetContext\(\); $req = $ctx.Request; $res = $ctx.Response; $file = $req.Url.LocalPath -replace '^/', ''; if \([string]::IsNullOrEmpty\($file\)\) { $file = 'index.html' }; $path = "D:\\EnCo Vendor Registration\\$file"; if \(Test-Path $path\) { $res.ContentType = if \($file.EndsWith\('.html'\)\) { 'text/html' } elseif \($file.EndsWith\('.jsx'\)\) { 'application/javascript' } elseif \($file.EndsWith\('.json'\)\) { 'application/json' } else { 'application/octet-stream' }; $res.OutputStream.Write\([System.IO.File]::ReadAllBytes\($path\), 0, [System.IO.File]::ReadAllBytes\($path\).Length\) } else { $res.StatusCode = 404; $res.OutputStream.Write\([System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetBytes\('Not Found'\), 0, 9\) }; $res.OutputStream.Close\(\) })
